captions.youtube_description:
Turn a repeated task into a tool you can actually use. In this tutorial, I walk through a newsletter editor, a task board with a delegation draft, a revenue model, and a packaging concept. We also cover selecting ideas and preparing a presentation.

Follow the screen demonstrations to see how inputs, calculations, previews and exports work, and how to test a result before relying on it. The examples use sample data and run locally. The video includes a brief recorded Claude build; the extended demonstrations use original tutorial tools.

The presenter is an AI avatar of Hammad Yousuf, with his authorized cloned voice.

captions.linkedin:
AI tools become useful when you can test what they actually do.

In this 29-minute walkthrough, I demonstrate four practical workflows:

• A newsletter editor with previews and exports
• A task board that prepares a delegation message
• A revenue model with visible assumptions and calculations
• A packaging concept for discussion and review

There are also examples of selecting ideas and preparing a presentation.

The screen recordings use original local tools and sample data, with a brief recorded Claude build. The task board creates a draft message; it does not send to Slack. The revenue model illustrates arithmetic, and the packaging example is a concept—not a manufacturing specification.

Watch one workflow, try it on a small task, and check the result before relying on it.

Which repeated task would you turn into a tool first?

Follow me for more practical AI walkthroughs.

AI disclosure: the presenter is an AI avatar of me, Hammad Yousuf, using my authorized cloned voice.

#AI #AIWorkflows #Productivity
